Ruling-pointer · objectstack-ai/objectstack#24378 re-ruled A at 6258883445 (batch #368 item 1, the maintainer's 「24378 同意 A」; supersedes B′) · director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) · 2026-10-19T03:20Z

For this card's scope: declared rules are read-only in Setup → Sharing Rules, with two actions — Disable (a `sys_metadata_activation` row of type `sharing_rule`, deployment-level, operator-gated under a wall) and Clone (a new stored rule under a new name). No in-place edit of a declared rule; a stored rule may not take a declared rule's name (the platform refuses it, 409). The platform side lands first (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24421's rework of PR #24428); this card stays `pm:blocked` on it.
